title: Disconnection Notices and the Security Deposit Review Extension
content:
**Collections rule for held Security Deposits whose satisfactory payment review is not passed.** Disconnection notices issued on the secured Electric Service Agreement in the review window add to the extension of the refund review date.

The review window is the kind's review months ending on the decision day, the day on which the review is decided: 12 months for the Residential New Service Deposit and the Residential Reestablishment Deposit, 24 months for the Residential Unauthorized Use Deposit, the Small Commercial Service Deposit and the Medium Commercial Service Deposit, and 36 months for the Large Power Service Deposit.

| Disconnection notices issued on the secured agreement in the window | Months added to the extension |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 3 |
| Exactly one | 1 |
| None | Nothing |

Each disconnection notice on the agreement's record counts as one notice, whether it is a written notice or a final notice. Notices on the customer's other agreements are not counted.

## Cases (hypothetical Small Commercial Service Deposit, 24-month window)

| Notices on the secured agreement in the 24 months ending on the decision day | Months added |
|---|---|
| A written notice and a final notice | 3 |
| One written notice 20 months before the decision day | 1 |
| One written notice 26 months before the decision day | Nothing (outside the window) |
| None on the secured agreement, two on another agreement of the customer | Nothing |
